import datetime,hashlib,json,pathlib,shutil
B=pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/actual-source-regular-local-collar-construct')
strict=json.loads((B/'runs/controls004/receipt.json').read_text());inv=json.loads((B/'runs/ordinary-inventory001/receipt.json').read_text());classified=json.loads((B/'CONTROLS_INVENTORY_CLASSIFIED.json').read_text())
assert strict['exit_code']==0 and inv['exit_code']==0 and classified['owned_constants']==55
assert classified['classification_counts']['public_prop_definition']==1 and classified['classification_counts']['public_prop_theorem']==1
S=B/'FalseControl.lean';assert not S.exists();assert not (B/'runs/false-control001').exists()
S.write_text("import RegularLocalCollarControls\n\nexample : RegularLocalCollarControls.omittedNonzeroDerivativeMutation := by\n  rw [show RegularLocalCollarControls.omittedNonzeroDerivativeMutation = False from\n    propext (iff_false_intro\n      RegularLocalCollarControls.not_omittedNonzeroDerivativeMutation)]\n")
cp=B/'FIRST_ID_CACHE.json';cache=json.loads(cp.read_text());st=S.stat();row={'path':str(S),'bytes':st.st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(S.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'first_observed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'origin':'FIRST actual CLOSED negative harness identity BEFORE its sole invocation'};cache[str(S)]=row
orig=B/'frozen/FalseControl.ORIGINAL.lean';shutil.copyfile(S,orig);so=orig.stat();cache[str(orig)]={**row,'path':str(orig),'marker':[so.st_size,so.st_mtime_ns],'origin':'Known exact initial negative original snapshot ID REUSED; no hash','copied_from':str(S)}
cp.write_text(json.dumps(cache,indent=2)+'\n')
r={'status':'CLOSED_SINGLE_OMITTED_DERIVATIVE_NEGATIVE_FROZEN_BEFORE_ONE_INVOCATION','observed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'harness':row,'complete_initial_snapshot':str(orig),'ordinary_strict_pass':str(B/'runs/controls004/receipt.json'),'ordinary_ALL55_std3_pass':str(B/'runs/ordinary-inventory001/receipt.json'),'ordinary_classification_corrected_from_stored_raw':str(B/'CONTROLS_INVENTORY_CLASSIFIED.json'),'already_passed_ordinary_object_identity_REUSED':cache[str(B/'build/RegularLocalCollarControls.olean')],'mutation':'ONLY actual input fderiv!=0 omitted at SAMEoriginalsample actualmax/fixedO; every chart/height/samechart-all-epsilon cut-slice output retained','harness_imports':['RegularLocalCollarControls'],'assumed_mutation_hypothesis_axiom_parameter':False,'counterproof_replayed':False,'ordinary_named_kernel':'NONE','sole_intended_negative_invocations_before_this_freeze':0,'expected_rejection':'Exactly one unsolved False goal, no setup/API/type/source errors'}
(B/'NEGATIVE_INITIAL_CUSTODY.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':r['status'],'observed_utc':r['observed_utc'],'harness':row,'prior_ordinary_strict_and_ALL55_std3':True}))
